verdict.rationale: Box hosts a live llms.txt file confirmed by direct probe (HTTP 200) plus documentation referencing it (box-docs-28), and this sits alongside a documented MCP server and agent-oriented guides, showing agents can be pointed at agent-native docs/endpoints. missing for 10: independent third-party confirmation that agents successfully consume the llms.txt content in practice, and no evidence of a machine-readable OpenAPI spec to complement it.
